events.title: New Demo Hotfix
events.summary: Hi Truckers, We've made a couple of smaller improvements.Fixed dialogue with the old man in Esperanza (Atos Lima)Fixed a crash when entering the workshop with a broken-down truck.Updated the appearance of the roadside, base, and workshop truck repair screens.Added descriptions for the selected truck part to the repair details panel across all three screen.Enjoy! P.S. So far it seems no one has found the secret place. Maybe it's too secret? But then, it's quite a large piece of land. ;)

events.title: The unluckiest game on Gamescom?
events.summary: Hey everyone! It’s like Fate put our team in the crosshairs. First, our Gamescom booth’s organizer withdrew 3 weeks before the event. Then, after last-minute onboarding with a new partner, our decorations got lost. We had to make use of what we have… Which is also the theme of our game. You start with an old, rusty truck and make your way up. events.title: Power of Landscapes
events.summary: Hi Truckers!One of the most fascinating aspects of a trucker’s job is the never-ending journey. From city to city, from town to town, trucks are carrying the precious cargo every day, traveling through diverse regions and changing landscapes outside the window. In the upcoming Road Truckers: New Beginning we have implemented various regions, to allow you to admire different landscapes, from breathtaking wild forests and mountains to more urban cities, towns, factories and mines. events.summary: Hello Truckers! We got so many questions about mouse steering in Road Truckers: New Beginning, and now we can just point you to the video below. We have it, and it works nice. events.title: How we deal with PHYSICS
events.summary: Hey, Truckers! In Road Truckers: New Beginning we wanted our truck to feel responsive on the road. This includes responsiveness to all the bumps you may encounter. That’s why we ensured that all our suspension points work nicely and react to the tiniest obstacles you may come across.You will be able to verify that as soon as in the Driving School, which serves as our basic tutorial.
